name: vibekeytester
description: Synthwave keyboard tester — press every key on your 104-key US keyboard and watch it light up on a glowing virtual board.

scripts.build:linux: node scripts/build-embedded.mjs && mkdir -p bin/linux-x64 && bun build --compile server/index.js --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile bin/linux-x64/vibekeytester
